text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Rhein Kraft suffered a serious injury,
I brought her straight to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... yes... this much is... no problem at all!
choice_data_list: You don't have to put on a brave face.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm not... putting on a brave face.
...I'm really not.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...The ideal Tiara Umamusume inside of me is—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...She's running so, so much further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I come to a halt because of an injury...
I feel like I'll just be left further and further behind...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back... to training
as soon as possible...
choice_data_list: Now is the time to rest.
We can still train the parts that aren't injured, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I persuaded her that she couldn't train to her full potential
while carrying the anxiety of an injury.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... You might not be able to
concentrate because of the injury..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Right now... I will focus on recovering...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: In return... once I'm all healed up, please give me some thorough training...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Even just that is more than enough...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: One, two—ouch!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, over something like this...
I can't afford to stop here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because her injury worsened,
Rhein Kraft was forced to take time off to rest,
swallowing her bitter frustration.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I definitely won't push myself too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —One, two, three, four.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —The injured spot... seems to be fine as well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: With this, it looks like I'll be able to return to full training right away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a reasonable training regimen, Rhein Kraft was able to make a smooth comeback.
